properties.site-address: St Cuthbert's Church Hall, Front Street, Bedlington
properties.notes: Scheme for development of 18 homes for affordable rent was completed in 2018/19 (03/00442/FUL). Involved redevelopment of land within settlement following the demolition of a church hall. Prior to this, two application were refused for change of use from church hall to 3 dwellings (08/00133/FUL) and for demolition and erection of 12 units (09/00003/FUL).
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
